{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import seaborn as sns"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Intervalos de confianza"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from scipy import stats\n",
    "from numpy import sqrt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "q95=stats.norm.ppf(0.95)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "array([6.52810469, 3.80031442, 4.95747597, 7.4817864 , 6.73511598,\n",
       "       1.04544424, 4.90017684, 2.69728558, 2.7935623 , 3.821197  ,\n",
       "       3.28808714, 5.90854701, 4.52207545, 3.24335003, 3.88772647,\n",
       "       3.66734865, 5.98815815, 2.58968347, 3.6261354 , 1.29180852])"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 4,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "np.random.seed(0)\n",
    "x = stats.norm.rvs(size=20, loc=3, scale=2)\n",
    "x"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "3.403068281311155"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 5,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x.mean() - q95*2/sqrt(20)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "x = np.linspace(-4,4,1000)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "[<matplotlib.lines.Line2D at 0x1a0134f1f70>]"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "\n",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "plt.plot(x, stats.norm.pdf(x), color='C0')\n",
    "plt.plot(x, stats.t.pdf(x,df=1), color='C1')\n",
    "plt.plot(x, stats.t.pdf(x,df=5), color='C2')\n",
    "plt.plot(x, stats.t.pdf(x,df=10), color='C3')\n",
    "plt.plot(x, stats.t.pdf(x,df=30), color='C4')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "2.0859634472658364"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 8,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "t995= stats.t.ppf(0.975,df=20)\n",
    "t995"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Intervalo de confianza: (-1.0782646182991178,1.0782646182991178 )\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print(f\"Intervalo de confianza: ({x.mean()-t995*x.std()/sqrt(20)},{x.mean()+t995*x.std()/sqrt(20)} )\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "2.1565292365982356"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "2*t995*x.std()/sqrt(20)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Librería statsmodel"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import statsmodels.stats.proportion as proportion"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Datos de ejemplo\n",
    "num_exitos = 120\n",
    "num_ensayos = 200\n",
    "confianza = 0.95\n",
    "alpha = 1 - confianza"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Calcular el intervalo de confianza\n",
    "intervalo = proportion.proportion_confint(num_exitos, num_ensayos, alpha=alpha, method='normal')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "(0.5321048559554297, 0.6678951440445703)"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 14,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "intervalo"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from scipy.stats import t"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Datos de ejemplo\n",
    "datos = np.array([15, 17, 20, 23, 18, 19, 21, 22, 16, 19])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 17,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Calcular la media y la desviación estándar de la muestra\n",
    "media_muestral = np.mean(datos)\n",
    "desviacion_estandar_muestral = np.std(datos, ddof=1)  # ddof=1 para calcular la desviación estándar muestral"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 18,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Nivel de confianza\n",
    "confianza = 0.95\n",
    "alpha = 1 - confianza"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 19,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Grados de libertad\n",
    "gl = len(datos) - 1"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 20,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Valor crítico de t\n",
    "valor_critico = t.ppf(1 - alpha/2, gl)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 23,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "2.2621571627409915"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 23,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "valor_critico"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 21,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Margen de error\n",
    "margen_error = valor_critico * desviacion_estandar_muestral / np.sqrt(len(datos))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 24,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "1.847043588899185"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 24,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "margen_error"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 22,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Intervalo de confianza\n",
    "limite_inferior = media_muestral - margen_error\n",
    "limite_superior = media_muestral + margen_error"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 25,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "17.152956411100813"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 25,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "limite_inferior"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 26,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "20.847043588899187"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 26,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "limite_superior"
   ]
  }
 ],
